summary: XRP ~$1.25, flat. Ripple released 1B XRP from escrow on 1 Nov in two unusual 500M transactions; usually ~70% is re-locked, but the odd pattern drew attention. The IMF's October stability report named the XRP Ledger as tokenised-finance infrastructure (not an endorsement). XRPL upgrade still due 4 Nov. Mostly holder price-ladder posts. Slightly less positive than this morning.
catalyst_note: 1B XRP monthly escrow release 1 Nov (unusual two-part); XRPL upgrade 4 Nov
